title: Unraveling the Ai2 Asta Scholarly Research Assistant Citation System

bias_targets.methodology: Analysis of the publication year distribution of cited references in generated reports to identify favoritism toward recent publications, specifically measuring the proportion of references published from 2020 onwards.
Evaluation of the 'Fields of Study' assigned to both the user queries and the retrieved references to identify a preponderance of specific academic disciplines like Medicine and Computer Science.
Ranking and analyzing the frequency of specific journals and preprint repositories (such as arXiv.org and PLoS ONE) appearing in reports to identify source overrepresentation.
Analyzing the citation-based impact (accumulated citation counts) of references selected by the AI tool to determine if it prioritizes highly-cited papers over less-cited but relevant works.
